CNLD.description: Nodal Load (CNLD). The outer key is the node number; ITEMS holds one entry per nodal load applied to that node, each tied to a static load case (LCNAME) and optionally a load group (GROUP_NAME).

ITEMS.description: List of nodal loads applied to the node. Each item is stored as a separate record keyed by (node, ID); a load case (LCNAME) plus optional load group determine which existing record is replaced.

ID.description: Serial number of this nodal load record within the node. Multiple loads can share a node with different IDs. Defaults to 0 (auto-assign / match existing by load case + group).

LCNAME.description: Static load case name. Must reference an existing static load case (STLD); otherwise the request fails.

GROUP_NAME.description: Load group name. Empty string means no group; if non-empty it must reference an existing load group.

FX.description: Nodal force in the global X direction.

FY.description: Nodal force in the global Y direction.

FZ.description: Nodal force in the global Z direction.

MX.description: Nodal moment about the global X axis.

MY.description: Nodal moment about the global Y axis.

MZ.description: Nodal moment about the global Z axis.
